events.title: Laboratory Corp. of America v. Davis, Luke, et al.
events.summary: The Supreme Court granted the motions of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument in the case of Laboratory Corp. of America v. Davis, Luke, et al. This procedural decision allows the Solicitor General to present arguments and share time during the oral proceedings, indicating the government's interest in the case.
events.why_relevant: The participation of the Solicitor General as amicus curiae can influence the Court's understanding and decision-making in the case.

events.title: Martin, Curtrina, et al. v. United States, et al.
events.summary: In the case of Martin, Curtrina, et al. v. United States, et al., the Supreme Court granted the motion of the Solicitor General for divided argument. This procedural order allows the Solicitor General to share time during oral arguments, reflecting the government's involvement and interest in the case.
events.why_relevant: The Solicitor General's participation in oral arguments can impact the Court's deliberations and the outcome of the case.

events.title: OK Charter School Board, et al. v. Drummond, Attorney General of OK
events.summary: The Supreme Court granted the motion of petitioners for divided argument and the motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument in the case of OK Charter School Board, et al. v. Drummond, Attorney General of OK. Justice Barrett did not participate in the consideration or decision of these motions.
events.why_relevant: The involvement of the Solicitor General and the granting of divided argument can affect the presentation and consideration of issues in the case.

events.title: Supreme Court defers consideration of partial stay applications in Trump v. CASA, Inc., et al., Trump v. Washington, et al., and Trump v. New Jersey, et al.
events.summary: The Supreme Court has deferred consideration of three applications for partial stays in the cases Trump v. CASA, Inc., et al. (24A884), Trump v. Washington, et al. (24A885), and Trump v. New Jersey, et al. (24A886). These applications were presented to individual justices and referred to the full Court. The Court has consolidated the applications and scheduled them for oral argument on May 15, 2025, with a total of one hour allotted for the proceedings.
events.why_relevant: The deferral and consolidation of these cases for oral argument indicate the Court's engagement with significant legal questions involving the former President.

events.title: Supreme Court releases opinion in Cunningham v. Cornell Univ. (23-1007)
events.summary: The Supreme Court released an official slip opinion in Cunningham v. Cornell Univ. Docket number(s): 23-1007.
events.why_relevant: The Supreme Court's official opinion in Cunningham v. Cornell Univ. is a primary legal source. Supreme Court opinions can define binding national law and alter the legal position of the executive branch, federal agencies, states, litigants, and democratic institutions.
